attchmntText: Dolat Algotech Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Outcome of Board Meeting held on November 14, 2026 for considering and approving for the issuance of Non-Convertible Debentures (NCDs) for an aggregate principal amount of up to Rs. 400 Crore (Rupees Four Hundred Crore only), in one or more tranches, on a private placement basis, in accordance with applicable laws and regulatory requirements. The details as required under SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 read with SEBI Master Circular No. HO/49/14/14(7)2025-CFD-POD2/I/3762/2026 dated 30th January, 2026, shall be submitted at the time of issuance and/or allotment of NCDs.

Dolat Algotech Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Outcome of Board Meeting held on November 14, 2026  for considering and approving for the issuance of Non-Convertible Debentures (NCDs) for an aggregate principal amount of up to ₹400 Crore (Rupees Four Hundred Crore only), in one or more tranches, on a private placement basis, in accordance with applicable laws and regulatory requirements.The details as required under SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 read with SEBI Master Circular No. HO/49/14/14(7)2025-CFD-POD2/I/3762/2026 dated 30th January, 2026, shall be submitted at the time of issuance and/or allotment of NCDs.
voiceSummary: Dolat Algotech Limited approved its unaudited financial results for the quarter and six months ended September 30, 2026. The Board also approved the issuance of Non-Convertible Debentures for an aggregate principal amount of up to 400 Crore on a private placement basis. For the quarter ended September 30, 2026, the company reported revenue from operations of 748.85 million and a profit after tax of 299.83 million. Earnings per share stood at 1.70. For the six-month period, revenue was 1,891.39 million with a profit after tax of 838.01 million. The debt-equity ratio as of September 30, 2026, is 0.09. The results were reviewed by the Audit Committee and approved by the Board on November 14, 2026.
